items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: From '29 on until he passed away. I think it was around '37, something like that...

ctx.x: So you made these recordings, and then you went off on the road with Joe Oliver. How long did you play with Joe Oliver?
From '29 on until he passed away. I think it was around '37, something like that...

items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I played the Graystone Ballroom with King Oliver. Two bands was featured there, Jean Goldkette's band and King Oliver's band.

ctx.x: What about Florida? Where did you play in Florida? And was this with the same traveling group?
Well, we didn't do too much with that particular show in Florida. All the stuff I did in Florida was with King Oliver.

I see. And Louisiana...? According to John Chilton's Who's Who Of Jazz, you were in Louisiana around this time, generally around the time that you went to Cuba. Do you recall anything outstanding about playing in Louisiana?
